== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Hoth: Echo Docking Bay]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100686 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100686], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100686-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>0ca14cb55a729f79af5974ae6350b41d99522d8f993fd28ee58a6ceda84d52a2</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
